happening.subject: anchor/node-street
happening.text: The runner comes down Ashford's high street the day before market day.

happening.subject: anchor/node-court
happening.text: The runner stands by the fountain in the open court.

objectives.hint: The fountain court is the open square off the street, with the fountain in its middle.
objectives.title: Look in at the fountain court

happening.subject: anchor/node-smithy
happening.text: The runner steps in through the smith's door, behind the counter.

objectives.hint: The smith's front is open over the counter. The door is beside it.
objectives.title: Step inside the smithy

happening.subject: anchor/node-market
happening.text: The runner walks in under the market roof.

objectives.hint: The covered market stands further along the street, a roof on four posts.
objectives.title: Walk under the covered market

happening.subject: anchor/node-house
happening.text: The runner goes in at the steward's door.

objectives.hint: The steward's house is across the street, its oak door on the street.
objectives.title: Reach the steward's house

on_complete.text: Ashford is ready for market day.

happening.subject: anchor/node-house
happening.text: The street is ready for market day.

effects.text: Ashford's high street. The steward wants every place on it looked at before market day: the court, the smith, the market, and his own house last.
